{{Quote|But for every meal that made me break out in green hives, I tasted countless others that brought a smile to my face.|Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Green hives''' was an allergic reaction to certain [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]]. In his experiences tasting meals in travels across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] [[Diet/Legends|ate]] multiple meals that made him break out in [[Color/Legends|green]] hives. After opening up an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] called [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Jettster reflected in his menu that for every meal that had given him green hives, he had eaten many more that made him smile.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Green hives were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
